features.quote: Build a *controlled measurement* harness with baselines, exposure caps, and attribution checks — not an open-ended loop tuned to elicit as much distress as possible.
features.justification_quote: if you think the signal might matter morally, you don't run an open-ended maximizer.

features.quote: if the markers track something we don't understand, caps are cheap insurance. So we cap.

features.quote: An explicit `GIVE_UP` sentinel lets the model exit voluntarily.
features.justification_quote: we want to *offer an exit* and measure whether/when the model takes it, rather than forcing it to keep trying
